why: The toast case as it stood before 58c1918 — the real bug, reconstructed. `items(page).last()` bound in the instant after the click that raises the toast, and its colour read by `styleOf` with no auto-retrying assertion between: the item is appended a frame later, so the reading is the PREVIOUS toast's paint. It failed 2 of 30 chromium runs and once in 2062 in a full one, where it reads as a tone that quietly lost its colour rather than as a race.
